summary: One reading as a dashboard tile: a small title, the value written large with its unit, and optionally a trend drawn faintly behind it, a change against an earlier period in its tone, a note, and a meter toward a target. A threshold scale (or a fixed color token) picks the reading's color, which inks the value or fills the whole tile. A null value says there is no data, in neutral ink and without its trend. It shares the dashboard panel's states (parts/dashboard-panel): loading, failed in the value's place with Retry, stale marked under the value. A tile with href or onSelect is one link or button, its info and menu still their own.

anatomy.tile: The box: at least 112 tall (144 with a target meter), radius-surface, a 1px border edge on card in card-foreground, clipping. Filled by its tone (colorMode background): the tone as a diagonal gradient, no edge, in on-fill. It takes its span's columns (parts/dashboard-panel), a sixth by default.
anatomy.spark: With sparkline and a value: the values as an area under a line, stretched across the tile's foot, 45 percent of its height (a quarter with a target), behind everything, in the value's ink (muted-foreground, the tone when inked, on-fill when filled) faded: the line at 70 percent, the area from 32 to 4 percent.
anatomy.head: The head row: at least 28 tall, 10 across, 4 over, its pieces 4 apart: the title, the change, info, the menu's button and an arranged grid's tools.
anatomy.title: The title in text.xs at weight 500, muted-foreground, at most two lines; one cut short gives its whole text on hover.
anatomy.delta: With delta and a value: an arrow (up unless the change starts with a minus, 14), the change in tabular figures at text.xs and 500, then what it is against (compared) at weight 400, cut short; titled with both. Its tone: good, critical when good is false, muted-foreground when good is not given.
anatomy.tool: info (a 12 info icon opening the tooltip with info, named words.info) and the menu's button (a 14 ellipsis, named and titled words.menu): 20 square, radius-md, in muted-foreground.
anatomy.value: The reading, centered in the room under the head, 10 across and 28 under: written by format, else with decimals and grouped thousands (en-US), in text.statistic with tabular figures; the unit 4 after it at text.sm and 500, in muted-foreground unless inked or filled. A null value says words.noData in text.detail-title and muted-foreground, with no unit.
anatomy.unit: With unit and a value: the unit 4 after the value on its baseline, at text.sm and weight 500, in muted-foreground unless inked or filled, when it takes the value's ink.
anatomy.note: With note: a line under the value in text.xs, muted-foreground, cut short.
anatomy.stale: With stale: parts/dashboard-panel's stale mark, under the value.
anatomy.meter: With target and a value: a meter under the value, 8 below it and 12 above the tile's foot, at most 192 wide, its pieces 4 apart: the track, then the target written out.
anatomy.track: The meter's track: 6 tall, radius-mini, in the value's ink at 15 percent; filled from its start in the value's ink as far as target(value, range) puts the reading (range from targetRange, else 0 to the larger of the reading and the target).
anatomy.tick: A mark at the target across the track: 2 wide, reaching 4 above and below it, radius-mini, in foreground (on-fill when filled).
anatomy.targetLabel: words.target, then the target written as the value is with a string unit after it (Target 99.5%), centered, at text.xs, the figure in the code face with tabular figures, in muted-foreground (on-fill at 85 percent when filled).
anatomy.failure: With error: what failed (error's own words, else words.failed) at text.xs in critical-ink, centered in the value's place, then Retry with onRetry: a 12 turning arrow and words.retry, a tool as wide as its words.
anatomy.cover: With href or onSelect: the whole tile is one link or button under the head and body, named the title and the value (Success rate: 99.3); info and the menu stay their own buttons over it.

value.does: The reading; null says there is no data.

decimals.does: Decimals the value is written with; when omitted, none for an integer or a value of 100 or more, else one. Thousands grouped (formatValue, en-US).

format.does: Writes the value and the target, in place of decimals.

thresholds.does: A threshold scale: [{ value?, color }], from each step's value up a reading takes its color token (good, warning, critical, chart-2); the first step covers everything below the second. A null value takes the first step's color, which a null value never draws.

color.does: A fixed color token, when the tile has no thresholds.

colorMode.does: value inks the value, its unit and its trend in the reading's color; background fills the tile with it, every ink on-fill; none leaves the color out.

sparkline.does: The values behind the reading, drawn as a faint area across the tile's foot.

delta.does: The change written for a reader: +12%, -0.4s. An arrow down when it starts with a minus, else up.

compared.does: What the change is against (vs yesterday), said after it.

good.does: Whether the change is an improvement: good or critical; neutral when omitted.

target.does: The value the reading aims for: a meter under the value with the target written out.

targetRange.does: The meter's ends [low, high]; from 0 to the larger of the reading and the target when omitted.

info.does: What the tile measures, in the info button's tooltip.

menu.does: The tile menu's items, as parts/dashboard-panel's menu.

href.does: Makes the whole tile one link, such as to the records its figure counts.

onSelect.does: Makes the whole tile one button, in place of href.

span.does: parts/dashboard-panel's span; a sixth by default, so tiles stand two to a row on a phone.

error.does: true, or what failed: the failure with Retry in the value's place; onRetry offers Retry.

stale.does: true, or since when: the value kept, the stale mark under it.

tile.note: At least 112; at least 144 with a target meter and a value.

head.note: At least 28 tall, 4 over its pieces.

title.note: text.xs at weight 500, as its paint says; at most two lines.

delta.note: text.xs at weight 500, as its paint says.

unit.note: text.sm at weight 500, as its paint says.

meterTop.note: Between the value and the meter.

tickOverhang.note: The tick reaches this far above and below the track.

sparkHeight.note: The trend's share of the tile's height; a quarter with a target meter.

meterMaxWidth.note: The target meter is at most this wide (max-w-48).

rest.means: The title, the value with its unit, in card-foreground on card.

hover.means: The pointer over a tile that is a link or a button: the hover wash and an edge in foreground at 25 percent; over a tool, its icon in foreground.
hover.reached: the pointer, with href or onSelect

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the tile's cover: the frame's focus outline in ring, focus-ring-width wide, drawn focus-ring-offset inside the tile's edge. On a tool: the outline in ring, focus-ring-width wide, with no offset.

inked.means: The reading has a color (thresholds or color) and colorMode is value: the value, its unit and its trend in that color, set at run time from the token the scale picks.

filled.means: colorMode background: the tile filled by the reading's color, no edge, every ink on-fill (the title, the change and the tools at 90 percent, the note and the target at 85).

good.means: A change that is an improvement: in good.

bad.means: A change that is not: in critical.

noData.means: A null value: words.noData in text.detail-title and muted-foreground, no unit, no trend, no change, no meter, no color.

loading.means: parts/dashboard-panel's loading: after 300 ms the body at half strength under the loading bar.

failed.means: The failure and Retry in the value's place, in critical-ink (on-fill at 90 percent when filled).

stale.means: The value kept, the stale mark under it.

filled.note: The ground is the reading's color token as a gradient (92 percent of it mixed with on-fill, to it at 70 percent; in dark, mixed with background at 80 and 62 percent), set at run time.

rest.note: Tabular figures; inked, the reading's color.
Inked or filled, the value's ink.

keyboard.does: Reaches the tile's cover, then info, the menu's button and an arranged grid's tools.
Follows the tile's link, or presses its button (Space too).
Opens the tile menu, its keys then parts/dropdown-menu's.
Closes the menu, focus back on its button.

appText.title: The tile's title; its unit, change, what the change is against, note, info and menu items.
appText.value: The reading, written by format or formatValue (decimals, grouped thousands, en-US): 3526 as 3,526, 99.3 as 99.3.
appText.error: What failed, in place of words.failed.
appText.stale: Since when, in place of words.stale.

sokkel-ui: The reading's color is set at run time as the CSS variable --tone from the token the scale picks (tokenVar); text-(--tone) inks, and the filled ground is a gradient of it, so neither is a resolved paint.
The track's ground and fill are bg-current at 15 percent and in full, following the value's ink.
The trend is an SVG area (SparkArea), its stroke not scaled with the box.
A title cut short sets its title attribute only while it is clamped (useClamped).
The words are a module-private object (WORDS: noData, info, menu, loading, target, and PANEL_STATE_WORDS spread in), merged under words.
formatValue writes en-US until a locale arrives (roadmap), as the table's counts do.
